acceptance_criteria.statement: Active dependency groups have exact locally observed versions, metadata hashes, and deterministic pin exports.
The unresolved cross-platform resolver lock is explicitly BLOCKED_EXTERNAL with an activation and verification path rather than a handwritten lock.

definition_of_done: Implementation and configuration for the bounded objective are complete.
Acceptance criteria have current automated or machine-readable evidence.
Required behavior tests pass for the affected foundation.
Traceability, plans, Jira, schemas, and developer documentation are current.
Security, provenance, observability, and rollback effects are explicit.
Unavailable external verification is represented without inflating completion.
description: Use pyproject.toml as declaration authority, generate an exact installed-environment lock and portable exports, record activation policy, and reject fabricated resolver output when package-index metadata is unavailable.
exclusions: No remote GitHub, Jira, AWS, package-index, or paid-service mutation is authorized.
No later persistent-state, durable-orchestration, scheduler, or Command Center capability is represented as complete.
objective: Make dependency declarations, activation groups, exact observed-environment pins, and the resolver-lock blocker deterministic and auditable.
observability_impact: Record stable correlation, diagnostic, quality, test, and evidence identities for later operational telemetry.
rationale: This bounded repository-engineering work converts accepted plans into executable, tested, self-validating foundation behavior without claiming later runtime capabilities.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Revert the bounded package/configuration changes, remove generated local runtime state, regenerate indexes and manifests, and retain the prior cumulative archive.
scope: Make dependency declarations, activation groups, exact observed-environment pins, and the resolver-lock blocker deterministic and auditable.
security_impact: Preserve least privilege, secret references, dependency provenance, input validation, and fail-closed external-effect boundaries.
title: Declare dependencies and verify explicit lock state
